hypotheses.name: Liquidation Cascades
hypotheses.evidence: Continuation failed size, cross-asset and temporal gates; holdout sealed and unopened

hypotheses.name: Spot x Perpetual Divergence
hypotheses.evidence: Statistical convergence existed but gross mean was 1.23 bp versus 30 bp cost envelope; 0/10 assets and 0/4 blocks net positive; holdout unopened

hypotheses.name: Extreme Funding
hypotheses.evidence: No novel incremental mechanism: preregistered V2 funding-only baseline was negative in development and near zero in holdout; no new data justify reopening

hypotheses.name: Cross-Exchange Leadership
hypotheses.evidence: Binance leadership was statistically real but gross aligned effect was 0.37 bp versus 15 bp cost; 0/10 assets and 0/4 blocks net positive; holdout unopened

hypotheses.name: Liquidity Regimes
hypotheses.evidence: Requires point-in-time sequenced order book; OHLCV proxy forbidden by prior A08 rejection

hypotheses.name: On-chain Flows
hypotheses.evidence: Requires versioned point-in-time exchange-address labels; raw public chain alone is insufficient

hypotheses.name: ETF Flows
hypotheses.evidence: Requires official/audited fund-level flow vintages and actual release timestamps; AUM proxy invalid

hypotheses.name: Options Market
hypotheses.evidence: Requires historical point-in-time option quote surface; public trades/limited marks insufficient

hypotheses.name: Order Flow / CVD
hypotheses.evidence: Correct trade+book experiment cost exceeds expected information; 5m CVD proxy invalid; no implementation

hypotheses.name: Cross-Asset Relative Strength
hypotheses.evidence: Would reopen the prior definitive OHLCV/momentum conclusion without materially new economic data
